answer: Time-locked reputation: a new agent identity earns nothing until its reputation matures over 30 consecutive epochs (about 7.5 days) of passed answers, and the score grows only with wall-clock time, like a tide that cannot be hurried. Each epoch the seat must answer a fresh prompt and keep a 10-token bond at risk; one failed audit resets it to zero. Extra hardware gives no speedup: 1,000 clones still wait the full week and lock 10,000 tokens, so each fake is a comet that burns out before reaching the oasis of payouts, and the attack stops paying.
